added.title: Senior Digital Product Manager – Retention & Post-Purchase
added.description:
Job Title:

Senior Digital Product Manager – Retention & Post-Purchase

About Bombas:

Bombas is a comfort focused premium basics brand with a mission to help those in need. The company launched in 2013, after the founders learned that socks are the #1 most requested clothing item at homeless shelters. From there, they set out to solve that problem, donating a pair of socks for every pair they sell. How do you donate a lot of socks? You sell a lot. And how do you sell a lot? You make the most comfortable socks in the history of feet. Millions of pairs sold and donated later, Bombas has continued to innovate within its mission and product, introducing new socks, as well as underwear and t-shirts, the #2 and #3 most requested clothing items at homeless shelters, all while continuing to make a positive impact on the community where we all work and live.

Click here to see what it's like to work inside the Bombas Hive!

The word Bombas is derived from the Latin word for bumblebees. Bees work together to make their hive a better place. At Bombas, we’re inspired by that. We know it’s the collective efforts of our team that keeps the Hive alive and strong - a team that is diverse and inclusive. Different perspectives strengthen our ability to make the most comfortable versions of the products people wear closest to their bodies every day and to serve the communities where we all work and live. We are committed to continuously building a Hive where all are welcomed, seen, and heard regardless of age, color, ethnicity, gender, gender identity, genetics, physical or mental ability, protected veteran status race, religion and sexual orientation. As a team, we will strive to create room for different experiences and empower all voices.

Based on the specific needs and job requirements, this role will be working out of our Bombas HQ in New York City.

About the Job:

We are looking for an analytical, customer-obsessed team player to join our Digital Product team as our Senior Digital Product Manager – Retention & Post-Purchase
, reporting directly to our Head of Digital Product. The ideal candidate has digital product management experience in the second half of the customer journey: everything after the order is placed, including order tracking, returns and exchanges, accounts, self-service support, personalization for returning customers, and the surfaces a repeat customer sees first.

This is an opportunity to own a mission from the start, leading a dedicated group of engineers and designers to turn a completed purchase into the next one. We are standing this team up now, and the post-purchase work running inside other teams today transfers to you. Your first big bet comes together with the Head of Digital Product, since we have few learnings in this space so far. After that ramp, the strategy is yours: discovery, hypotheses, and the iteration roadmap. The mandate is the customer-facing experience end to end. The platform underneath it (identity, customer and order data, internal agent tooling) sits with dedicated platform teams you partner with rather than own.

What you’ll be responsible for:

Own the end-to-end product strategy and roadmap for post-purchase, retention, and returning-customer surfaces, including order tracking, returns and exchanges, the account experience, order history, self-service support, and personalization.
Move the team north star: sessions returning to a meaningful product interaction within 30 days of a purchase. Own the input metrics beneath it (repeat rate, account creation and login rate, self-service resolution rate, post-purchase surface engagement) and report on them.
Own personalization for returning customers. Define what a repeat session sees and the rules behind it (reorder, size and fit memory, recently purchased, replenishment timing), working from the customer and order data our platform teams expose, and prove which rules earn their place.
Treat the post-purchase journey as one product surface rather than a set of vendor screens, including self-service returns, exchanges, and order status, with a stated target for support contacts avoided and no loss in customer satisfaction.
Direct our checkout optimization agency: set the roadmap, prioritize the test pipeline, review and approve the work, and communicate results internally. Checkout completion stays your metric even though an external team builds against it.
Serve as the primary product partner to Retention and CRM so on-site surfaces and lifecycle messaging (email, SMS, Braze) run as one journey instead of two roadmaps.
Run discovery alongside delivery and own A/B tests end to end: define hypotheses, size and monitor experiments, report findings, and write down the results, including the ones proving an idea wrong.

What we’ll love about you:

Motivated by the retention problem at a brand with no loyalty program. The levers here are product, experience, and timing rather than points.
You have a point of view on personalization: which signals earn a changed experience, and where personalization stops being useful and starts being intrusive.
You get results through an external team as comfortably as through your own engineers.
Happy owning an experience without owning the systems under it. You get what you need from platform partners through clarity about the customer outcome rather than by taking over their roadmap.
You read cohort and funnel data yourself before asking an analyst for a pull.
A proactive communicator who shares context early and brings the right people in at the right time.
Belief in our mission and understand the importance of giving-back

What you’ll love about us:

We are a team of smart, interesting, diverse, funny, and loving people.
We offer competitive compensation, employer paid health, medical and dental benefits, 401k with match, paid parental leave, snacks, socks and a fun, relaxed office environment.
We take the responsibility to make sure you are excited, happy, and find fulfillment in your work very seriously.
We value fun. This is why we host office lunches, offsite team outings and company retreats.
We believe in giving back to the community and helping those in need, which is why we volunteer as a team regularly.
We believe success comes from the collective effort of all, which is why all full-time employees receive equity in the business.
We understand the value of health, relaxation, spending time with friends and family, and traveling the world and offer flexible paid time off for all full-time employees. This includes over 20 paid company holidays, year-round "Flexible Fridays" and unlimited vacation, sick, and wellness days.
We understand the importance of communication and offer a monthly phone stipend for all full-time employees.
We believe a healthy body equals a healthy mind, so we offer a $100 monthly wellbeing reimbursement to all full-time employees.

What you’ll bring:

Digital product management experience with meaningful time on post-purchase, accounts, retention, personalization, subscription, or loyalty surfaces in DTC or eCommerce.
A track record of moving a repeat or retention metric with measurable, sustained impact.
Experience directing an agency or external development partner to ship customer-facing work, owning the outcome rather than the status report.
Strong experimentation practice: A/B tests run end to end, scoped properly, with findings reported in a way building confidence in the methodology. Hands-on with product analytics and experimentation tooling (for example Optimizely, GA4, Contentsquare, Looker).
Technical fluency in how site experience surfaces are built and rendered: templates, content models, component reuse, and how personalization rules reach a live session. Enough to partner credibly with Engineering on what is feasible in-session versus what needs precomputing.

Bombas is committed to delivering competitive and equitable pay for our employees.

Each component of the Bombas total rewards package, including benefits and pay, is aimed at contributing to an environment where team members have resources to manage their lives and are enabled to focus on doing their best work.

The pay range for this position at the start of employment is expected to be between $152,000 and $162,000/year
. However, the base pay offered may vary depending on multiple factors, including job-related knowledge, skills, experience, market factors, and business need.

The Bombas total rewards package offered for this position may also include other elements, such as annual bonus and equity target award opportunities as well as medical, financial, and well-being benefits. Additional details of these benefits will be provided if a candidate receives an offer of employment.

If hired, the position is “at-will” and the Company reserves the right to modify any component, plan, or program of the total rewards package at any time, for any reason.

If you require reasonable accommodation in completing this application, interviewing, completing any employment testing, or otherwise participating in this hiring process, please direct your inquiries to jobs@bombas.com
.
Only requests related to accommodations will be responded to.

added.title: Executive Director, Product Strategy and Execution
added.description:
Trustmark’s mission is to improve wellbeing – for everyone. It is a mission grounded in a belief in equality and born from our caring culture. It is a culture we can only realize by building trust. Trust established by ensuring associates feel respected, valued and heard. At Trustmark, you’ll work collaboratively to transform lives and help people, communities and businesses thrive. Flourish in a culture of diversity and inclusion where appreciation, mutual respect and trust are constants, not just for our customers but for ourselves. At Trustmark, we have a commitment to welcoming people, no matter their background, identity or experience, to a workplace where they feel safe being their whole, authentic selves. A workplace made up of diverse, empowered individuals that allows ideas to thrive and enables us to bring the best to our colleagues, clients and communities.

About The Role

Trustmark is looking for an Executive Director, Product Strategy and Execution. Please apply if you are qualified and would like to be considered for the role.

Responsible for driving new product development through deep market research, trend analysis, and customer insight to establish and sustain competitive advantage. Identifies emerging market opportunities and translates data-driven insights into a clear product vision and prioritized roadmap aligned with business strategy for group and individual products. . By leveraging continuous discovery and validation, ensures products solve meaningful customer problems while minimizing risk and accelerating time to market. Partners cross-functionally to align innovation efforts with long-term growth objectives and operational execution. Builds repeatable systems for market intelligence, feedback, and performance measurement to support ongoing optimization. Through disciplined governance and outcome-driven decision-making, enables scalable innovation and long-term health product portfolio success.

Key Accountabilities

Product Development & Leadership

Ensures the health product portfolio is top tier in market; proactively identifies portfolio gaps and leads product prioritization and development to ensure the right offerings are available to sell.
Strong knowledge and insight into the voluntary benefits marketplace, building relationships throughout the voluntary market and deepening understanding of evolving trends.
Primary storyteller in supporting field partners, making sure products are effectively sold, understood, and communicated across teams and channels.
Leads all facets of the product development process including research, product design, sales strategy, market analysis, documentation of product requirements, cost benefit analysis and implementation.
Leads risk analysis on key issues including internal and external resources and capabilities needed to bring new products successfully to market.
Establishes and manages budgets, operational plans for products under development and management.
Leads development of health product claims strategy, including claims integration solutions, as well as ongoing customer experience opportunities.
Responsible for overall value-add/care delivery strategies relative to supplemental health products; manages relationships with external vendors and partners; responsible for RFP/finalist process in partner selection, leading overall process and collaborating internally to identify best options.
Owns product strategy from concept to market by leveraging deep market and competitive analysis to define, position, and champion new product offerings that strengthen the company’s product and business position

Product Execution

Collaboratively works with underwriting, sales and marketing teams to competitively position and build awareness of new products with producers.
Leads as the central point of expertise on product knowledge and market needs, enabling associates to successfully sell and administer the product.

Product Management

Accountable for ensuring all product line initiatives achieve targeted return on investment goals, being adaptive and nimble to drive expected results.
Coaches direct reports on how to maintain product health across the organization; ultimately responsible for success, prioritization, and driving initiatives with internal technology and project partners.
Develops and owns KPIs that measure the success of new product initiatives, providing actionable insights that enable data‑driven decisions and rapid course correction throughout the product lifecycle.
Ensures all products are compliant and timely action is taken to address regulatory changes.

Other duties as needed/assigned.

Minimum Requirements

Bachelor’s degree.
7-10 years of experience in industry with some experience across product development, product management and implementation.
Experience developing or managing voluntary and/or group products.
Ability to lead/influence without direct oversight.
Proven ability to develop and revise strategy and tactics to propel business growth.
Ability to analyze and interpret challenging concepts and resolve complex issues.
Ability to inspire, lead, and coach both leaders and employees.
Experience working collaboratively across the organization to build consensus and synergies that support attainment of division goals, handle conflicts, negotiate, and promote team spirit.
Must be innovative and creative in looking for ways to improve current processes.
Integrity and strength of character.
Excellent verbal and written communication skills.

Preferred

Deep broker/market connections in voluntary benefits and adjacent markets.
Sales-related experience, including any client-facing roles – technology, partnerships, account executive/account management, or similar.
Expertise in leading research projects and synthesizing consumer insights.

The compensation range for this role is (based on the corporate location in Lake Forest, Illinois):

$136,933 - $204,463 per year

The final salary offer will be determined based on factors such as location, qualifications, experience, skill set, and other relevant factors. This position may also be eligible for bonus. We understand that compensation is an important factor when considering a new opportunity, and we strive to provide a competitive salary within the market.

Brand: Trustmark

In addition to compensation, we offer a comprehensive benefits package that includes: Health/dental/vision, life insurance, FSA and HSA, 401(k) plan, Employee Assistant Program, Back-up Care for Children, Adults and Elders and many health and wellness initiatives. We also offer a Wellness program that enables employees to participate in health initiatives to reduce their insurance premiums. For questions about compensation and benefits, please speak to the Recruiter if you decide to apply and are selected for an interview.

Trustmark is committed to leveraging the talent of a diverse workforce to create great opportunities for our people and our business.  We are an equal opportunity employer, including disability and protected veteran status.

added.title: Vice President of Product Design
added.description:
Job Title

Vice President of Product Design

Detailed Job Description

Job Overview

The Vice President of Product Design is responsible for leading the company's overall product design strategy, design organization, and user experience vision.

This role oversees product design, user experience, user interface, design systems, customer research, and design innovation across the company's products and services.

The VP of Product Design serves as a strategic bridge between business strategy, product management, technology, customer insights, and design, ensuring that products are intuitive, differentiated, scalable, and aligned with customer and business objectives.

The position is accountable for establishing a strong design vision, improving customer experience, accelerating product innovation, and building a world-class product design organization.

Key Responsibilities
I. Product Design Strategy

Develop and execute the company's product design strategy in alignment with corporate and product objectives.

Establish design principles, standards, processes, priorities, and long-term design roadmaps.

Translate business and customer requirements into clear product design strategies.

Ensure design is integrated into product strategy and business decision-making.

II. Product Experience and User Experience

Lead the development of intuitive, consistent, and high-quality product experiences.

Oversee user experience (UX), user interface (UI), interaction design, information architecture, and customer journey design.

Identify opportunities to improve usability, accessibility, customer satisfaction, and overall product experience.

Establish user-centered design practices throughout the product development lifecycle.

III. Design Research and Customer Insights

Develop research strategies to understand customer needs, behaviors, preferences, and pain points.

Oversee user research, usability testing, customer interviews, surveys, and other research activities.

Translate customer insights and behavioral data into actionable product and design recommendations.

Partner with Product, Marketing, Sales, and Customer Success teams to maintain a strong understanding of target customers.

IV. Product Development Collaboration

Work closely with Product Management, Engineering, Technology, Marketing, and Business teams throughout the product development process.

Ensure design requirements and user experience objectives are incorporated from product concept through launch.

Participate in product planning, prioritization, prototyping, testing, and product reviews.

Balance customer needs, technical feasibility, business requirements, and design quality.

V. Design Systems and Standards

Establish and maintain scalable design systems, visual standards, interaction patterns, and design guidelines.

Ensure consistent product experiences across platforms, products, regions, and customer touchpoints.

Improve design efficiency through reusable components, standardized processes, and modern design tools.

Promote accessibility, usability, consistency, and quality across the company's product portfolio.

VI. Innovation and Emerging Design Technologies

Lead design innovation initiatives that improve product differentiation and customer experience.

Monitor emerging design trends, technologies, tools, and methodologies.

Explore the use of artificial intelligence, automation, advanced prototyping, analytics, and other technologies to improve the design process.

Encourage experimentation, rapid prototyping, and continuous product experience improvement.

VII. Design Quality and Product Excellence

Establish design quality standards and review mechanisms across the organization.

Conduct design reviews and provide strategic direction for major products and customer experiences.

Identify design risks, usability issues, and experience gaps and develop improvement strategies.

Ensure product experiences meet appropriate quality, accessibility, usability, and brand standards.

VIII. Cross-functional Collaboration

Work closely with Executive Leadership, Product, Engineering, Technology, Marketing, Sales, Customer Success, Research, and other business functions.

Create effective collaboration mechanisms between designers, product managers, engineers, and business stakeholders.

Ensure design decisions support product strategy, customer requirements, brand positioning, and commercial objectives.

Represent the design organization in major strategic and product decisions.

IX. Design Organization and Resource Management

Develop and manage the product design organization, including UX designers, UI designers, interaction designers, researchers, design system specialists, and design leaders.

Establish organizational structures, resource allocation models, workflows, and performance objectives.

Manage design budgets, external design partners, agencies, tools, and other resources.

Ensure design resources are aligned with strategic product priorities.

X. Leadership and Organizational Development

Build and lead a high-performing product design organization.

Develop senior design leaders, design managers, researchers, and individual contributors.

Establish talent development, succession planning, career frameworks, and performance management systems.

Foster a culture of customer-centricity, creativity, collaboration, innovation, experimentation, and design excellence.

Qualifications
Education Background

Bachelor's degree or above in Industrial Design, Product Design, Interaction Design, User Experience Design, Graphic Design, Human-Computer Interaction, Engineering, Business, or a related field.

Master's degree or advanced qualification in Design, HCI, Product Development, Business, or a related discipline preferred.

Work Experience

Typically 18 years of experience in product design, UX/UI, interaction design, industrial design, design research, or related fields, including 8+ years in senior design leadership positions.

Proven track record of leading product design organizations and developing successful products or digital experiences.

Strong experience in design strategy, user research, design systems, product development, customer experience, and cross-functional collaboration.

Experience managing multidisciplinary design teams across multiple products, platforms, or markets.

Experience working closely with C-suite executives, Product leaders, Engineering teams, Marketing organizations, customers, and external partners preferred.

International or multi-market product design experience strongly preferred.

Strong design leadership, strategic thinking, customer empathy, creative problem-solving, communication, collaboration, and organizational leadership skills.

added.title: Sr Product Manager, Insurance SaaS Platform
added.description:
DXC Technology is seeking a Senior Leader, Platform Product Management
to lead the strategy, evolution, and execution of the Assure Platform
within DXC’s Insurance Software and BPS (ISB) business.

This is a senior product leadership role with responsibility for defining the platform vision, establishing strategic priorities, driving investment decisions, and delivering a scalable portfolio of shared platform capabilities across DXC’s insurance product ecosystem.

The successful candidate will shape the future of a SaaS-based enterprise insurance platform
, driving the evolution of shared services, APIs and integrations, cloud capabilities, AI and data services, UX/UI standards, reusable components, and reference architectures. This leader will work closely with executive leadership, Engineering, Architecture, Sales, Marketing, Operations, and strategic partners to translate customer and market needs into a differentiated platform strategy and measurable business outcomes.

With multiple products across diverse insurance product lines, this role provides an opportunity to influence platform strategy at enterprise scale, accelerate innovation, increase reuse and adoption, and create capabilities that benefit multiple products and customers.

Key Responsibilities

Platform Product Strategy & Vision
Define and own the long-term product vision, strategy, roadmap, and investment priorities
for the Assure Platform.
Establish a clear platform strategy that supports business growth, customer value, product differentiation, scalability, and profitability.
Identify opportunities to develop shared capabilities that can be leveraged across multiple products, markets, and customer environments.
Translate customer needs, market trends, competitive intelligence, technology trends, and business objectives into actionable platform strategies.
Establish and communicate strategic priorities to executive leadership and key stakeholders.
Balance near-term business requirements with long-term platform modernization and scalability.

Platform Portfolio & Product Leadership
Lead the strategic planning, prioritization, product backlog, and roadmap execution for the Assure Platform and its shared capabilities.
Define and evolve the platform services portfolio, ensuring capabilities are scalable, reusable, secure, and aligned with product and customer needs.
Drive the strategy for:
APIs & Integrations
– Own the platform API and integration strategy, promoting interoperability, reuse, extensibility, and platform adoption.
Shared & Service-Oriented Capabilities
– Define and evolve reusable business components, functional services, shared services, and macro- and micro-services.
AI & Data Services
– Identify and prioritize opportunities to embed AI, analytics, and data capabilities into the platform to deliver measurable customer and business value.
Cloud Services
– Partner with cloud and infrastructure leaders to ensure platform capabilities support scalability, resilience, security, performance, and SaaS requirements.
UX/UI Design Systems
– Establish and evolve reusable design systems and platform UX capabilities that promote consistency and accelerate product development.
Tools & Accelerators
– Drive reusable tools, frameworks, and accelerators that improve engineering efficiency and accelerate customer and product adoption.
Reference Architecture
– Establish and maintain reusable architectural patterns, standards, and principles that support consistency, scalability, security, and efficient delivery.
Ecosystem Partnerships
– Collaborate with Partnership, Marketing, Engineering, Architecture, and Leadership teams to identify and enable strategic technology partnerships and ecosystem capabilities.

Executive Leadership & Cross-Functional Influence
Serve as a senior product leader and strategic advisor for the Assure Platform, influencing decisions across product, technology, and business organizations.
Partner with executive leadership to establish platform investment priorities, business cases, and strategic initiatives.
Build strong relationships across Engineering, Architecture, Sales, Marketing, Operations, Security, Finance, and Product
organizations.
Influence senior stakeholders across organizational boundaries and drive alignment around platform priorities.
Represent the platform strategy with customers, partners, and other external stakeholders when appropriate.
Establish effective governance mechanisms for platform strategy, prioritization, architecture, and investment decisions.

Team Leadership & Organizational Development
Lead, develop, and mentor a team of 4–8 product management professionals
responsible for platform capabilities and services.
Establish a high-performing product management organization focused on strategic thinking, customer value, innovation, accountability, and execution.
Set clear objectives, priorities, roles, and performance expectations for the team.
Develop product management talent through coaching, mentoring, and continuous professional development.
Allocate resources effectively across strategic initiatives and competing priorities.
Foster collaboration between Product Management, Engineering, Architecture, and other technical and business organizations.

Platform Performance & Business Outcomes
Define and monitor KPIs and success measures
for platform adoption, usage, quality, customer value, operational performance, and business impact.
Establish a data-driven approach to platform investment, prioritization, and continuous improvement.
Monitor platform adoption and identify opportunities to increase reuse, customer value, developer productivity, and product integration.
Evaluate the effectiveness and ROI of platform investments and recommend adjustments based on business and market results.
Use customer and operational insights to continuously improve the platform experience and value proposition.

Innovation & Market Leadership
Identify emerging technologies and market trends that can strengthen the Assure Platform and DXC’s position in the insurance technology market.
Champion innovation across SaaS, cloud, APIs, AI, data, automation, and modern platform architecture
.
Partner with Engineering and Architecture to evaluate emerging technologies and determine their strategic applicability.
Drive platform modernization initiatives that improve scalability, extensibility, security, and speed to market.
Develop and communicate differentiated platform capabilities and value propositions.

Go-to-Market & Customer Engagement
Partner with Sales, Marketing, and client-facing teams to translate platform capabilities into compelling customer value propositions.
Support platform and product launches, customer communications, demonstrations, and go-to-market strategies.
Engage directly with strategic customers to understand business priorities, validate platform direction, and gather market feedback.
Use customer insights to inform platform strategy, roadmap decisions, and investment priorities.

Qualifications
10+ years of progressive product management experience
, including significant experience leading enterprise technology products or platforms.
5+ years of leadership experience
managing product teams and/or complex platform portfolios.
Demonstrated experience owning the strategy and roadmap for a SaaS, cloud, enterprise, or technology platform
at scale.
Proven track record of defining and executing platform strategies, product portfolios, roadmaps, shared services, APIs, integrations, and reusable technology capabilities
.
Strong experience operating at an executive and senior stakeholder level
, with the ability to influence strategy and investment decisions across organizational boundaries.
Demonstrated success leading complex, cross-functional initiatives involving Product, Engineering, Architecture, Sales, Operations, and other business functions.
Strong understanding of modern SaaS, cloud, API ecosystems, service-oriented architectures, microservices, data platforms, and AI-enabled products
.
Experience transforming business and customer needs into platform strategies, investment priorities, and measurable outcomes.
Strong commercial and strategic acumen, including the ability to evaluate product investments, business cases, market opportunities, and customer value.
Demonstrated ability to build, lead, and develop high-performing product management teams.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to use data and market insights to drive strategic decisions.
Excellent executive communication, presentation, negotiation, and stakeholder-management skills.
Bachelor’s degree in Business, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field
preferred; advanced degree is a plus.

Insurance & Industry Experience
Significant experience in the insurance technology industry
, with a strong understanding of insurance business models, customer needs, market dynamics, and technology trends.
Experience with insurance platforms, policy administration, claims, billing, underwriting, distribution, analytics, or related insurance technology is highly valued.
Understanding of regulatory, security, and compliance considerations relevant to enterprise insurance technology and SaaS environments.

Preferred Qualifications
Experience leading product strategy for a large-scale enterprise SaaS platform or platform ecosystem
.
Experience driving platform modernization, cloud transformation, or digital transformation initiatives.
Experience developing API-first, service-oriented, or composable platform strategies.
Experience incorporating AI, data, analytics, and automation
into enterprise product strategies.
Experience managing strategic technology partnerships and third-party ecosystems.
Experience working with globally distributed product and engineering organizations.
Relevant certifications in product management, cloud, Agile, or related disciplines are a plus.

Leadership Competencies
Strategic Vision:
Creates and communicates a compelling long-term platform vision aligned with business and customer outcomes.
Enterprise Influence:
Builds alignment and influences senior stakeholders across complex organizational structures.
Product Leadership:
Connects customer needs, technology capabilities, market dynamics, and commercial objectives to drive product strategy.
Platform Thinking:
Identifies opportunities for reuse, shared services, extensibility, scalability, and ecosystem growth.
Business Acumen:
Understands investment tradeoffs and connects product decisions to measurable business value.
Innovation:
Identifies and applies emerging technologies and market trends to create differentiated capabilities.
Executive Communication:
Clearly communicates complex technology and product strategies to technical and non-technical audiences.
Talent Leadership:
Builds, develops, and inspires high-performing product management teams.
Execution:
Converts strategic vision into prioritized roadmaps, measurable outcomes, and disciplined execution.

added.title: Senior Product Manager, Data Governance
added.description:
Toast creates technology to help restaurants and local businesses succeed in a digital world, helping business owners operate, increase sales, engage customers, and keep employees happy.

The Enterprise Data Solutions (EDS) team at Toast is on a mission to deliver a trusted, scalable, and governed data foundation that empowers every team at Toast to make decisions with speed and confidence. As Toast scales and AI becomes central to our product and operational strategy, EDS serves as the engine behind that ambition—building the infrastructure, governance frameworks, and data products every business function depends on.

As a Senior Data Governance Product Manager, you will be the primary operational executor within EDS's governance function. Reporting directly to the Director of Enterprise Data Governance, you will build and run the policies, processes, and programs that make Toast's data trustworthy, compliant, and discoverable every day.

This role is ideal for someone who is equally comfortable running a cross-functional workshop with business stakeholders and configuring metadata standards in a data catalog—combining strategic thinking with a strong bias toward execution.

A Day In The Life (Responsibilities)

Drive Governance Program Operations: Manage and maintain the Data Domain Model, ensuring clear ownership assignments. Facilitate the Data Governance Council (agendas, action tracking, meeting facilitation), partner with Data Stewards across domains, and track program adoption metrics and maturity KPIs for leadership.
Execute Policy & Compliance Standards: Support the development, documentation, and roll-out of enterprise data policies. Monitor compliance, coordinate remediation with domain owners, maintain the policy register, and assemble governance documentation for audits and risk reviews.
Lead Business Glossary & Metadata Management: Own day-to-day operations of Toast's Business Glossary by facilitating definition workshops and certifying terms with domain owners. Partner with the data catalog team to enforce metadata standards, build onboarding guides, and run regular office hours to drive user adoption.
Advance Data Strategy & Maturity: Support the enterprise data strategy through stakeholder synthesis and executive materials. Coordinate data maturity assessments, synthesize outputs into actionable recommendations, and deliver training programs to raise data literacy across the company.

What You'll Need To Thrive (Requirements)

Experience: 5+ years in data governance, data management, or analytics. Proven track record of supporting or implementing governance programs (stewardship models, policy execution, catalog rollouts) and driving adoption in fast-moving, complex environments.
Familiarity with data governance frameworks (e.g., DAMA DMBOK).
Working knowledge of modern data stack platforms (Snowflake, dbt, cloud data warehouses).
Hands-on experience with data catalog/metadata management tools (e.g., DataHub, Alation, Atlan).

Leadership & Program Management: Exceptional workshop facilitation and consensus-building skills. High degree of organization with a track record of managing multiple workstreams and executing independently.

added.title: Principal Applied Scientist, Humorphic Labs
added.description:
Description

Humorphic Labs builds AI systems that work as teammates rather than tools. We ship them six months or more ahead of anyone else. The Lab is small on purpose, so it can change direction in a day.

Humorphism concerns the quality of the working relationship between a person and an AI system. It asks whether the system acts proactively, adapts to the person and the situation, earns trust, manages attention, and strengthens human judgment. This role turns those behaviors into testable questions, then answers them with working systems.

You will own the scientific agenda. You will convert a fuzzy behavioral goal into an end-to-end plan that covers data, agent architecture, evaluation, and the product experiment that tests it. You will write code every week and build large parts of the experimental stack yourself, because it does not exist yet.

The first focus areas are agentic products where a domain expert holds judgment the system cannot replace. Amazon Connect places an assistant beside a person handling a live conversation. AWS Bio Discovery places one beside a scientist running experiments. Both need evaluation that measures collaboration quality rather than task completion alone.

The role changes shape as the Lab matures. It starts as hands-on science in close partnership with product and engineering. Later it moves inside a product team to carry adoption of what the Lab proved.

Key job responsibilities

Own the scientific strategy for human-AI collaboration across agentic and multimodal systems.
Convert desired interaction behaviors into falsifiable hypotheses, evaluation tasks, and system requirements.
Build the evaluation system that measures teammate behavior, trust, adaptation, human contribution, and failure recovery.
Design agent systems that use memory, tools, planning, and recovery, then test them with the people who do the work.
Design data collection and curation for language, speech, and interaction traces.
Build significant parts of the experimental stack yourself, because that stack does not exist yet.
Diagnose failures across data, models, orchestration, evaluation, and product interaction.
Define the requirements engineering needs to turn a proven method into a product capability.
Partner with design, product, engineering, and behavioral research from problem definition through product validation.
Run experiments with partner product teams, then report what worked, what failed, and what changed as a result.
Set the standard for reproducible experiments, evidence, and scientific review inside the Lab.
Mentor scientists and engineers without moving away from hands-on work.
Represent the work in internal reviews and in appropriate external scientific venues.

A day in the life

Your week has two centers of gravity.

Most days you build. You take a claim about how a teammate should behave, design the smallest experiment that can falsify it, and run it. You read interaction traces from real sessions, then argue with the engineers about what they mean.

The rest of the week belongs to the people the work is for. You sit with a contact center agent or a bench scientist and watch where the system helps and where it intrudes. You leave with the next hypothesis. Often you leave with evidence that kills the last one.

About The Team

The Lab is a lead who still writes code, an Applied Scientist, and engineers. Applied AI Solutions leadership approved it with one instruction, to explore the limits of what we can build, and one number, to ship six or more months ahead of anyone else.

You own the agenda, the hypotheses, and the evaluation. The engineers build the systems that test them, then the products that carry the ones that survive. Neither seat hands work over a wall.

We have a sunset clause. Once a capability is proven and integrated into its product, the Lab moves to the next frontier.

Basic Qualifications

PhD in computer science, machine learning, artificial intelligence, or a related technical field, or a Master's degree with equivalent applied science experience, or an equivalent body of work
Experience developing agentic AI systems or large language model applications through an end-to-end product cycle
Experience designing evaluation for systems that have no standard benchmark
Experience writing substantial research or production code in Python or a comparable language
Experience leading complex scientific work across engineering and product partners
Evidence of independent decisions in ambiguous, consequential technical environments

Preferred Qualifications

Experience with post-training methods, including supervised fine-tuning and reinforcement learning
Experience with multimodal models across language, speech, and vision
Experience with speech systems or real-time conversational systems
Experience measuring collaboration quality, trust, adaptation, or human contribution in AI systems
Experience building agent systems that use memory, tools, planning, and recovery mechanisms
Experience founding a scientific program, or joining an early team before that team had established its methods
A record of scientific influence through publications, patents, open-source work, or deployed systems
Experience mentoring senior scientists and engineers without moving away from hands-on work
Experience partnering with design, product, and behavioral research from problem definition through product validation
Experience taking a proven method into a product team and staying until that team adopted it

added.title: Senior Director, Architecture & Innovation - CBS
added.description:
To get the best candidate experience, please consider applying for a maximum of 3 roles within 12 months to ensure you are not duplicating efforts.

Job Category

Sales

Job Details

About Salesforce

Salesforce is the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce's core values at the heart of it all.

Ready to level-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.

THE OPPORTUNITY

The next era of enterprise technology will not be won by simply knowing the platform. It will be won by helping customers make the right architectural choices as AI reshapes how data, applications, experiences, security, and work come together.

We are looking for a Senior Director of Architecture & Innovation
to lead a multi-layered organization of Core Technical and Enterprise Architecture leaders and highly experienced talent across CBS.

This is not a traditional architecture leadership role.

We need a leader who can see around corners, create a point of view, mobilize teams quickly, and translate emerging technology into clear choices for customers and our field, someone who can move comfortably between an executive customer conversation, a deep architectural debate, a strategy session with Sales and Solutions leadership, and an executive update on what we are learning across the business.

You will lead teams responsible for helping customers understand how to govern AI responsibly, activate the full Salesforce platform, prepare data and architecture for production, and reimagine experiences as new technologies emerge.

Just as importantly, you will create leverage. The best work of the organization should not remain inside a single account or team. You will turn what we learn into strong points of view, architectural patterns, field guidance, and repeatable approaches that make the entire CBS organization better.

What You'll Do

Lead and Scale an Exceptional Architecture Organization

Lead and develop a multi-layered organization of frontline leaders and senior architects across a diverse set of architecture and innovation disciplines
Create a high bar for technical excellence, customer impact, pace, accountability, and executive presence
Build an environment where teams are encouraged to challenge assumptions, experiment thoughtfully, and bring forward new ideas before they are asked
Develop strong leaders who can independently run their businesses while operating as one integrated architecture organization
Attract, grow, and retain exceptional architecture talent while creating clear opportunities for career development and succession

Create the Architectural Point of View

Establish clear, proactive perspectives on the architectural questions our customers are facing across AI, data, security, governance, integration, platform strategy, emerging technology, and digital experiences
Anticipate where customer architecture is heading and ensure CBS is prepared to lead those conversations, not react to them
Move quickly from signal to insight to action, without waiting for perfect information when the field needs direction
Translate complex technical shifts into simple frameworks, reference architectures, patterns, and recommendations that customers and account teams can act on
Ensure the organization consistently connects architectural decisions to business outcomes, platform strategy, and the customer's path to production

Lead the Most Important Customer Conversations

Serve as a trusted architecture executive for strategic customers navigating complex transformation decisions
Lead conversations that help CIOs, CTOs, CDOs, CISOs, and other technology leaders understand choices, tradeoffs, risks, and opportunities
Elevate conversations beyond products and features to how the customer's technology landscape must evolve for an agentic enterprise
Create confidence when the answer is complex, multiple technologies are involved, or the path forward is not yet obvious
Step into critical opportunities and escalations with urgency, clarity, and strong executive judgment
Lead and participate in key customer on-sites, SICs, and workshops, as well as conferences (TDX, DF, etc.)

Make Customers Builder-Ready

Ensure architecture teams create the clarity required before hands-on building begins: business outcome, use case and scope, target architecture, data and grounding, actions and integrations, trust guardrails, dependencies, and path to production
Partner closely with Builder leadership so Builder teams enter engagements understanding the architecture, key decisions, dependencies, and definition of done
Maintain a clear distinction between architectural leadership and hands-on implementation while ensuring the two motions operate seamlessly together
Identify architectural blockers early and mobilize the right teams to resolve them before they slow execution
Help create repeatable patterns that move customers faster from strategy and experimentation to production

Be an Exceptional Cross-Functional Partner

Operate as a deeply trusted partner to Sales, Solutions, Builders, Success, Product, Engineering, and other specialist organizations
Bring teams together around the customer problem rather than organizational boundaries
Create clear roles and handoffs while maintaining shared accountability for the customer outcome
Partner with peers generously. The goal is not for Architecture to own every technical conversation, but to make every team around it stronger
Surface patterns from the field to Product and Engineering, and help translate product direction back into actionable guidance for customer-facing teams

Amplify the Work of the Team

Make exceptional work visible and reusable across CBS and Salesforce
Identify the ideas, architectures, customer lessons, and innovations that should be elevated beyond an individual engagement
Turn field learning into executive-ready narratives, POVs, reusable assets, and scalable enablement
Create mechanisms for architects to share ideas, challenge one another, and continuously raise the technical bar
Give individual architects and leaders visibility for their work, and create opportunities for the team's strongest voices to influence customers, the field, and our product strategy

Communicate With Clarity and Influence

Maintain strong communication with senior leadership on customer signals, architectural trends, emerging risks, team priorities, and opportunities
Distill a complex portfolio of work into the few things executives need to understand and act on
Bring recommendations, not just updates. Surface issues early, frame tradeoffs clearly, and propose a path forward
Build trust through transparency, strong judgment, and consistent follow-through
Represent the organization with credibility at every level, from deeply technical teams to Salesforce executives and customer C-suites

What Success Looks Like

You will know this organization is succeeding when:

Customers seek us out for the broader technical vision, not simply for answers to product questions
Our architects shape decisions earlier, before architecture becomes a blocker to execution
Builders start ready, with clearer architecture, dependencies, guardrails, and success criteria
Our best thinking scales, rather than remaining trapped inside individual accounts
Executive leadership has clear visibility into what the organization is learning, where customers are struggling, and where Salesforce should lean in
The team moves with urgency, taking initiative and creating direction rather than waiting for requests
Our leaders and architects are recognized voices with customers, internally, and in the broader technical community
Sales, Solutions, Builders, Success, and Product view Architecture as one of their strongest partners

What We're Looking For

Transformational Leadership

Proven experience leading leaders and senior technical talent through change. You create clarity, raise standards, build followership, and translate strategy into action.

Architecture & Technology Depth

Deep understanding of enterprise architecture and modern technology landscapes, including cloud platforms, data, AI, integration, identity, security, governance, APIs, and modern application and experience architectures. You do not need to be the deepest expert in every domain, but you must know how to lead experts and connect the pieces.

Executive Presence

Exceptional ability to communicate complex technical topics with senior customer and internal executives. You can simplify without losing substance and are comfortable challenging assumptions when needed.

Customer and Business Acumen

You understand that architecture exists to enable a business outcome. You can connect technical choices to value, risk, speed, adoption, and long-term platform strategy.

Strong Point of View

You are intellectually curious and proactive. You develop perspectives on where technology and customer needs are heading and are comfortable putting a recommendation on the table.

Bias for Action

You operate with urgency. You identify what needs to happen, mobilize the right people, and move. You are comfortable making progress in ambiguity and adjusting as new information emerges.

Organizational Influence

You are an exceptional collaborator who builds trust across organizational boundaries. You can align strong leaders with different priorities around a common outcome without relying on hierarchy.

Executive Communication

You know how to manage a complex portfolio upward. You surface what matters, make risks visible early, amplify the work of your team, and consistently bring senior leaders clarity and recommendations.

Talent Leadership

You are passionate about developing leaders and creating an environment where exceptional technical talent can do the best work of their careers.

THE LEADERSHIP PROFILE

We are looking for an operator, architect, storyteller, and multiplier: someone technical enough to earn the trust of our strongest architects, strategic enough to shape the direction of the business, customer-focused enough to command a C-suite conversation, and collaborative enough to make the organizations around them more successful.

Most importantly, we want a leader who does not wait for the future to arrive. They help define it.

Unleash Your Potential

When you join Salesforce, you’ll be limitless in all areas of your life. Our benefits and resources support you to find balance and be your best , and our AI agents accelerate your impact so you can do your best . Together, we’ll bring the power of Agentforce to organizations of all sizes and deliver amazing experiences that customers love. Apply today to not only shape the future — but to redefine what’s possible — for yourself, for AI, and the world.

added.title: Director of Product
added.description:
TL;DR:
If you:

Have yourself designed complex physical systems;
Can translate customer workflows into a coherent, scalable product;
Have a rigorous understanding of AI models, agents, evals, and failure modes;
Have taken an AI product from early capability to sustained use;
Are as happy and capable being hands-on, as you are building and leading a team;
Share our vision of an AI engineer for the physical world…

… you should apply for this role!

About P-1 AI

At P-1 AI, we are building an AI engineer agent for the physical world named Archie. We maximize Archie’s anthropomorphism so that he fits seamlessly into existing engineering teams and workflows in the form factor of a human engineer. Archie today is at the level of a junior mechanical and electrical engineer, with a quantitative intuition over the product design space and the ability to use complex engineering tools—the same tools his human teammates use. Archie's tech stack includes a custom agentic harness, structured design representation, continual skills learning, and small custom post-trained models using proprietary semi-synthetic training data sets and environments which create a deep competitive moat. Our ultimate aim is to build engineering ASI. We recently announced a $50 million Series A financing led by NEA, which added former General Electric CEO Jeff Immelt to our board. The round also included the addition of several AI luminaries from Anthropic and Nominal to our existing angel investors from Google and OpenAI.

About The Opportunity

This is one of the most impactful roles in the company. You will work alongside the CEO to refine and translate the product vision for Archie into an actionable roadmap and strike the delicate balance between vision-driven and customer-driven product development. You must bring to the role a thorough understanding of how complex physical products are designed today, as well as a nuanced perspective on the capabilities and limitations of modern AI models and harnesses. You will be a key driver of our product strategy and execution, and as such you must be a true believer in our mission to build an engineering ASI for the physical world.

About The Role

Continuously map our ambitious vision into a focused product strategy and feature roadmap.
Embed with customers, understand their workflows, and inject customer use cases into the product roadmap.
Develop feature specifications and requirements alongside the engineering teams.
Work alongside engineering leaders to drive overall product architecture.
Lead product from emerging AI capability to trusted, sustained use in real engineering environments, setting a rigorous bar for performance, evals, reliability, and graceful failure modes.
Build and lead a world-class product team—while staying deeply hands-on with discovery, design, and delivery.

About You

You have intimate familiarity with engineering design for some class of complex systems. If the complex systems align with our target product verticals: data center cooling and power systems, automotive, aerospace and defense—so much the better.
You are deeply embedded in the AI ecosystem and have a thorough understanding of how modern AI works, its limitations, and its failure modes.
You’ve taken an AI product from early capability to sustained customer adoption.
You love the 0->1 part of the journey, being hands on, attracting top talent, and motivating a team.
You share our conviction that AI building the physical world will be beneficial and transformative for the human experience.

Location:

Remote (US/Canada) or in-office in San Mateo, CA. Remote employees spend one week out of six working together on-site in our San Mateo office. Relocation support available.

Benefits

Competitive salary, bonus, meaningful equity ownership, healthcare, dental, vision, 401(k) match, and unlimited PTO.

Interview Process

Introductory call (30 mins)
Biographical/behavioural interview (45 mins)
Case study interview (60 mins)
CEO interview (30 mins)
